item.title: AI Era: Unemployment and Wealth Explosion Coexist for Two Different Groups
item.description: Discover how the AI era creates parallel worlds: while a small number of people amass massive wealth from semiconductors and AI technologies, more face unemployment anxiety. This in-depth analysis uses South Korea, SK Hynix, and the widening wealth gap as real-world examples.
